items.title: OTF Inclusion: Creating a Space Where Everybody Belongs
items.summary: Meet Nikki Puzzo and Melissa Baran, the Swampscott women behind OTF Inclusion, a fitness class that makes movement accessible, welcoming and empowering for people of all abilities.
items.body:
Sometimes the most meaningful things happening in our communities start with a personal story—and a couple of people determined to make a difference.

Meet **Nikki Puzzo**, a Swampscott mom, and **Melissa Baran**, studio manager and head trainer at Orangetheory Fitness Swampscott, the women behind **OTF Inclusion**, a fitness class designed to make movement accessible, welcoming, and empowering for individuals of all abilities.

![Nikki Puzzo and her daughter Stella](assets/otf-inclusion-nikki-stella.jpg)

The inspiration behind the program is Nikki's daughter, Stella, who has cerebral palsy. As a mom, Nikki has seen firsthand the challenges individuals with disabilities can face when it comes to finding opportunities to participate, build confidence, and feel included.

But Stella has also taught her something incredibly powerful: having a disability doesn't define what someone can accomplish. Sometimes, it simply means finding a different way to get there.

Together, Nikki and Melissa created OTF Inclusion with a mission that goes far beyond exercise.

In this class, success isn't measured by how fast you run, how much weight you lift, or how many repetitions you complete. It's about showing up, trying something new, celebrating progress, and discovering what your body can do.

More than anything, it's about creating a community where every participant feels supported, celebrated, and proud of themselves.

**Because fitness should be accessible to everybody.**

We're so proud to spotlight Nikki and Melissa for turning a personal inspiration into something that creates opportunities, builds confidence, and makes our community a little more inclusive.

**Interested in OTF Inclusion, or know someone who might benefit from the program?** Reach out to the team at Orangetheory Fitness Swampscott to learn more about the class and how to get involved.

items.title: Bespoke Collective Pop-Up: Shop Now Through Dec 2
items.summary: Winthrop's new boutique isn't open yet, but you can already shop! Bespoke Collective is popping up inside Bespoke Events at 8 Michaels Mall through December 2: gifts, clothing, accessories, holiday essentials and more.
items.body:
There's a new spot to put on your holiday shopping list. **Bespoke Collective** is a thoughtfully curated lifestyle boutique and intimate event space coming to **1 Michaels Mall in Winthrop**.

## Shop the pop-up now

The new storefront is still a few weeks away, but you don't have to wait. Get a sneak peek and a head start on your holiday shopping at the **Bespoke Collective Pop-Up inside Bespoke Events, 8 Michaels Mall, Winthrop**, now through **December 2**. Shop gifts, clothing, accessories, holiday essentials and more.

**Pop-up hours:**

- Tuesday 11/24: 9 AM – 7 PM
- Wednesday 11/25: 9 AM – 4 PM
- Thursday 11/26: Closed (Happy Thanksgiving!)
- Friday 11/27: 12 – 6 PM
- Saturday 11/28: 9 AM – 2 PM
- Sunday 11/29: 12 – 3 PM
- Monday 11/30: 10 AM – 6 PM
- Dec 1–2: check [@_bespokecollective_](https://www.instagram.com/_bespokecollective_/) for hours

**Shop online anytime** at [bespokecollectivema.com](https://bespokecollectivema.com). Shipping and local pickup available!

## Coming soon to 1 Michaels Mall

**The shop:** Special collections and cute, one-of-a-kind gifts, from clothing for women, men, kids and babies to jewelry, beauty and skincare, candles and home décor, books and paper goods, and party supplies.

**The Studio:** An intimate event space for private parties, kids' birthdays, showers, milestone celebrations, workshops and classes.

Shop small, shop local. Welcome to the neighborhood, Bespoke Collective!
